decisions.decision: Entity page segmented toggle follows Figma design — timeline first, graph second
decisions.rationale: Timeline is the default view, matching the existing prose sentence approach

decisions.decision: Place pages get timeline view matching entity pages
decisions.rationale: Parity between entity and place detail pages — both are discovery tools

decisions.decision: Authority identifiers shown as full-width rows with codes, not compact pills
decisions.rationale: Figma design shows wider rows with external link icon, label, and code — more informative

decisions.decision: Country codes shown as full Spanish names via Intl.DisplayNames
decisions.rationale: PE to Peru is more meaningful than ISO codes for general users

decisions.decision: Coordinates moved from map corner to Control section metadata field
decisions.rationale: Proper metadata placement, matching ISAD(G) control area pattern

decisions.decision: Place.js uses IIFE pattern instead of DOMContentLoaded
decisions.rationale: DOMContentLoaded already fired by the time script at bottom of body registers listener

decisions.decision: Map init isolated in separate IIFE from main logic
decisions.rationale: MapLibre CDN failures were killing the main page logic — separation ensures timeline/filters still work
206K pages OOM at default 4GB heap. CI uses 6GB but local needs 8GB due to other processes
